sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `paying_subscribers_on_promo_rate`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription`.`promotional_rate_flag` = TRUE

SELECT `subscription_plan`.`service_tier`, ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(`subscription`.`termination_date`, `subscription`.`activation_date`)), 1) AS `average_days_on_last_plan`, COUNT(*) AS `cancelled_subscriptions`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Cancelled'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`service_tier` IS NOT NULL
  AND `subscription`.`termination_date` IS NOT NULL
  AND `subscription`.`activation_date` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `subscription_plan`.`service_tier`
ORDER BY `average_days_on_last_plan` DESC

WITH `cancelled_accounts` AS (
  SELECT `churn_event_id`, `subscriber_id`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event`
),
`cancellations_with_failed_payment` AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.`churn_event_id`
  FROM `cancelled_accounts` c
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`invoice` i
    ON c.`subscriber_id` = i.`subscriber_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`payment` p
    ON p.`invoice_id` = i.`invoice_id`
  WHERE p.`payment_status` = 'Failed'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cancelled_accounts`) AS `total_cancellations`,
  COUNT(*) AS `cancellations_with_failed_payment`,
  try_divide(COUNT(*) * 1.0,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `cancelled_accounts`)) AS `share_with_failed_payment`
FROM `cancellations_with_failed_payment`

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `annual_paying_subs_up_for_renewal_next_60_days`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription`.`subscription_type` = 'Annual'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription`.`current_term_end_date` IS NOT NULL
  AND `subscription`.`current_term_end_date` BETWEEN DATE'2026-11-10' AND DATE_ADD(DATE'2026-11-10', 59)

WITH `viewing_by_bucket` AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN `playback_session`.`video_resolution` = '4K' THEN '4K'
      ELSE 'Rest'
    END AS `resolution_bucket`,
    try_divide(SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `watch_hours`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
  WHERE `playback_session`.`video_resolution` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CASE
      WHEN `playback_session`.`video_resolution` = '4K' THEN '4K'
      ELSE 'Rest'
    END
)
SELECT
  `resolution_bucket`,
  `watch_hours`,
  try_divide(100.0 * `watch_hours`,SUM(`watch_hours`) OVER ()) AS `viewing_percent`
FROM `viewing_by_bucket`
ORDER BY `viewing_percent` DESC

SELECT 'Film' AS `content_category`, AVG(`runtime_minutes`) AS `avg_runtime_minutes`
FROM (
  SELECT try_divide(CAST(`runtime_seconds` AS DOUBLE),60.0) AS `runtime_minutes`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`title`
  WHERE `content_type` = 'Film'
    AND `runtime_seconds` IS NOT NULL
) AS `film`
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Regular series episode' AS `content_category`, AVG(`runtime_minutes`) AS `avg_runtime_minutes`
FROM (
  SELECT try_divide(CAST(`runtime_seconds` AS DOUBLE),60.0) AS `runtime_minutes`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`content_episode`
  WHERE `episode_type` = 'Episode'
    AND `runtime_seconds` IS NOT NULL
) AS `episode`

SELECT `series`.`series_status`, COUNT(*) AS `series_count`, AVG(`series`.`total_season_count`) AS `avg_seasons`, MIN(`series`.`total_season_count`) AS `min_seasons`, MAX(`series`.`total_season_count`) AS `max_seasons`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`series` AS `series`
WHERE `series`.`series_status` IS NOT NULL
  AND `series`.`total_season_count` IS NOT NULL
  AND `series`.`series_status` IN ('Ongoing', 'Completed')
GROUP BY `series`.`series_status`
ORDER BY `avg_seasons` DESC

WITH subtitle_counts AS (
  SELECT
    `playback_session`.`subtitle_language`,
    COUNT(`playback_session`.`playback_session_id`) AS `sessions`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
  WHERE `playback_session`.`subtitle_language` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `playback_session`.`subtitle_language`
), ranked_subtitles AS (
  SELECT
    `subtitle_language`,
    `sessions`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `sessions` DESC) AS `subtitle_rank`
  FROM subtitle_counts
)
SELECT
  `subtitle_language`,
  `sessions`
FROM ranked_subtitles
WHERE `subtitle_rank` = 1
ORDER BY `subtitle_language`

SELECT campaign_type, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN end_date < CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS past_end, SUM(CASE WHEN start_date > CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_started FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.campaign WHERE campaign_status = 'Live' GROUP BY campaign_type ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1001

SELECT campaign_status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN end_date >= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) OR end_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_flight, MAX(end_date) AS max_end, MIN(end_date) AS min_end FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.campaign GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 1001

SELECT order_type, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(total_contracted_value) AS gross_contracted_value, SUM(net_order_value) AS net_value FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.ad_order GROUP BY order_type ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 1001

SELECT 'strategic_tier' AS tier_type, p.strategic_tier AS tier, COUNT(*) AS deals, SUM(d.deal_value_amount) AS total_value, COUNT(DISTINCT p.partner_id) AS partners, SUM(CASE WHEN d.deal_status = 'Active' THEN d.deal_value_amount END) AS active_value, MIN(d.currency_code) AS c1, MAX(d.currency_code) AS c2 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.acquisition_deal AS d JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.partner AS p ON d.partner_id = p.partner_id GROUP BY p.strategic_tier UNION ALL SELECT 'risk_tier', p.risk_tier, COUNT(*), SUM(d.deal_value_amount), COUNT(DISTINCT p.partner_id), SUM(CASE WHEN d.deal_status = 'Active' THEN d.deal_value_amount END), MIN(d.currency_code), MAX(d.currency_code) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.acquisition_deal AS d JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.partner AS p ON d.partner_id = p.partner_id GROUP BY p.risk_tier LIMIT 1001

SELECT p.partner_type, COUNT(*) AS deals, SUM(CASE WHEN d.deal_expiration_date < CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_but_past_expiry FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.acquisition_deal AS d JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_partner.partner AS p ON p.partner_id = d.partner_id WHERE d.exclusivity_flag = TRUE AND d.deal_status = 'Active' GROUP BY p.partner_type ORDER BY deals DESC LIMIT 1001

WITH c AS (SELECT ce.churn_event_id, ce.subscriber_id, ce.last_viewed_title_id, ce.churn_timestamp, s.territory_id FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.churn_event AS ce JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS s ON s.subscriber_id = ce.subscriber_id), f AS (SELECT c.*, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window AS w WHERE w.title_id = c.last_viewed_title_id AND w.territory_id = c.territory_id AND w.active_flag) AS live_now, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window AS w WHERE w.title_id = c.last_viewed_title_id AND w.territory_id = c.territory_id AND w.window_open_date <= CAST(c.churn_timestamp AS DATE) AND (w.window_close_date IS NULL OR w.window_close_date >= CAST(c.churn_timestamp AS DATE))) AS live_at_churn FROM c) SELECT COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT subscriber_id) AS subs, SUM(CASE WHEN last_viewed_title_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_title, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT live_now THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_live_now, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT live_now THEN subscriber_id END) AS subs_no_live_now, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT live_at_churn THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_live_at_churn, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT live_at_churn THEN subscriber_id END) AS subs_no_live_at_churn FROM f LIMIT 1001

WITH cur AS (SELECT s.subscriber_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription AS s JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription_plan AS p ON p.subscription_plan_id = s.subscription_plan_id WHERE s.subscription_status = 'Active' AND p.plan_type = 'Paid' GROUP BY s.subscriber_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS impressions, COUNT(DISTINCT i.subscriber_id) AS subs, MAX(cur.n) AS maxn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery WHERE delivery_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND delivery_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE)) AS total_oct FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i JOIN cur ON cur.subscriber_id = i.subscriber_id WHERE i.delivery_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.delivery_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1001

SELECT t.content_type, COUNT(*) AS impressions, SUM(i.cpm_realized) / 1000 AS ad_revenue, AVG(i.cpm_realized) AS avg_cpm FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.content_episode AS e ON i.content_episode_id = e.content_episode_id LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.title AS t ON e.title_id = t.title_id GROUP BY t.content_type ORDER BY ad_revenue DESC LIMIT 1001

SELECT t.territory_group AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.subscriber_id) AS distinct_viewers, COUNT(*) AS impressions FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS ps ON ps.playback_session_id = i.playback_session_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS s ON s.subscriber_id = ps.subscriber_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS t ON t.territory_id = s.territory_id WHERE i.delivery_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.delivery_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY t.territory_group ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1001

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ps.subscriber_id) AS total_distinct, COUNT(*) AS impressions FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS ps ON ps.playback_session_id = i.playback_session_id WHERE i.delivery_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.delivery_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1001

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `invoice_date`) AS `month`,
    SUM(`subtotal_amount` - `discount_amount`) AS `revenue_amount`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`invoice`
  WHERE `invoice_date` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `invoice_date`)
), ranked_months AS (
  SELECT
    `month`,
    `revenue_amount`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `revenue_amount` DESC) AS `revenue_rank`
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT
  `month`,
  `revenue_amount`
FROM ranked_months
WHERE `revenue_rank` <= 1
ORDER BY `revenue_amount` DESC, `month` ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS `active_accounts`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber`
WHERE `account_status` = 'Active'

SELECT t.name, COUNT(*) AS invoices, SUM(i.subtotal_amount - i.discount_amount) AS revenue_ex_tax, SUM(i.total_amount_due) AS billed_incl_tax, SUM(i.amount_paid) AS collected, SUM(CASE WHEN i.invoice_status = 'Paid' THEN i.subtotal_amount - i.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS rev_paid_invoices FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_billing.invoice AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber AS s ON i.subscriber_id = s.subscriber_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS t ON s.territory_id = t.territory_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Japan%' AND i.invoice_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY t.name LIMIT 1001

SELECT
  try_divide(SUM(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`),3600.0) AS `total_watch_time_hours`,
  COUNT(`playback_session`.`playback_session_id`) AS `playback_sessions`,
  AVG(`playback_session`.`total_watch_duration_seconds`) AS `average_watch_time_per_session_seconds`,
  AVG(`playback_session`.`completion_percentage`) AS `completion_rate`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session` AS `playback_session`
WHERE `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` >= ADD_MONTHS(DATE'2026-11-09', -6)
  AND `playback_session`.`session_start_timestamp` < DATE_ADD(DATE'2026-11-09', 1)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS impressions, COUNT(DISTINCT i.playback_session_id) AS sessions, SUM(i.total_impressions_served) AS imp_sum FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session AS p ON i.playback_session_id = p.playback_session_id WHERE p.platform_type = 'Tablet' AND i.delivery_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND i.delivery_date < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1001

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `paying_subscribers_partner_bundle`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
  AND `subscription`.`acquisition_channel` = 'Partner bundle'

SELECT g.name AS genre, COUNT(*) AS impressions, SUM(i.viewable_impressions) AS viewable FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery AS i JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.content_episode AS e ON i.content_episode_id = e.content_episode_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.series AS s ON e.content_series_id = s.series_id JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_content.genre AS g ON s.genre_id = g.genre_id GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY impressions DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT t.territory_id, t.name, w.availability_status, w.active_flag, w.blackout_flag, (w.window_open_date <= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) AND (w.window_close_date IS NULL OR w.window_close_date >= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE))) AS in_dates, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT title_id) AS titles FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window AS w JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.territory AS t ON t.territory_id = w.territory_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%German%' AND w.window_type = 'SVOD' GROUP BY ALL LIMIT 1001

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT blackout_flag THEN title_id END) AS available_titles, COUNT(DISTINCT title_id) AS incl_blackout FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window WHERE territory_id = 12 AND window_type = 'SVOD' AND active_flag AND availability_status = 'Active' AND window_open_date <= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) AND (window_close_date IS NULL OR window_close_date >= CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE)) LIMIT 1001

WITH switch_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    s_old.`subscriber_id`,
    s_old.`subscription_id` AS `old_subscription_id`,
    s_new.`subscription_id` AS `new_subscription_id`,
    p_old.`base_price` AS `old_base_price`,
    p_new.`base_price` AS `new_base_price`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY s_old.`subscription_id`
      ORDER BY s_new.`activation_date`, s_new.`subscription_id`
    ) AS `rn`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS s_old
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS s_new
    ON s_old.`subscriber_id` = s_new.`subscriber_id`
   AND s_old.`termination_date` = s_new.`activation_date`
   AND s_new.`activation_date` IS NOT NULL
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS p_old
    ON s_old.`subscription_plan_id` = p_old.`subscription_plan_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS p_new
    ON s_new.`subscription_plan_id` = p_new.`subscription_plan_id`
  WHERE s_old.`subscription_status` = 'Superseded'
    AND p_old.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
    AND p_new.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
    AND p_old.`base_price` IS NOT NULL
    AND p_new.`base_price` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT try_divide(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN `new_base_price` < `old_base_price` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),COUNT(*)) AS `downgrade_share_percent`
FROM switch_pairs
WHERE `rn` = 1

WITH regional_reasons AS (
  SELECT
    `territory`.`territory_group` AS `region`,
    `churn_event`.`cancellation_reason_description` AS `cancellation_reason_description`,
    COUNT(*) AS `cancellations`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`churn_event` AS `churn_event`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
    ON `churn_event`.`subscription_id` = `subscription`.`subscription_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
    ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscriber` AS `subscriber`
    ON `churn_event`.`subscriber_id` = `subscriber`.`subscriber_id`
  JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_rights`.`territory` AS `territory`
    ON `subscriber`.`territory_id` = `territory`.`territory_id`
  WHERE `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
    AND `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` >= DATEADD(MONTH, -12, TIMESTAMP'2026-11-10 00:00:00')
    AND `churn_event`.`churn_timestamp` < TIMESTAMP'2026-11-11 00:00:00'
    AND `territory`.`territory_group` IS NOT NULL
    AND `churn_event`.`cancellation_reason_description` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `territory`.`territory_group`, `churn_event`.`cancellation_reason_description`
), ranked_reasons AS (
  SELECT
    `region`,
    `cancellation_reason_description`,
    `cancellations`,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY `region` ORDER BY `cancellations` DESC) AS `reason_rank`
  FROM regional_reasons
)
SELECT
  `region`,
  `cancellation_reason_description`,
  `cancellations`
FROM ranked_reasons
WHERE `reason_rank` = 1
ORDER BY `region`, `cancellation_reason_description`;

WITH `monthly_collected` AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `invoice_date`) AS `month`,
    SUM(`amount_paid`) AS `cash_collected`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`invoice`
  WHERE `invoice_date` IS NOT NULL
    AND `invoice_date` >= DATE'2026-08-01'
    AND `invoice_date` < DATE'2026-11-01'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `invoice_date`)
)
SELECT AVG(`cash_collected`) AS `three_month_average_cash_collected`
FROM `monthly_collected`

WITH `monthly_refunds` AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `processing_date`) AS `month`,
    SUM(`amount`) AS `processed_refund_amount`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`refund`
  WHERE `refund_status` = 'Processed'
    AND `processing_date` IS NOT NULL
    AND `processing_date` >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', DATE'2026-11-10')
    AND `processing_date` < ADD_MONTHS(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', DATE'2026-11-10'), 12)
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', `processing_date`)
), `running_refunds` AS (
  SELECT
    `month`,
    `processed_refund_amount`,
    SUM(`processed_refund_amount`) OVER (ORDER BY `month` ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `running_total`
  FROM `monthly_refunds`
)
SELECT
  `month`,
  `processed_refund_amount`,
  `running_total`
FROM `running_refunds`
WHERE `running_total` > 100000
ORDER BY `month`
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `mega_fan_members_today`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`service_tier` = 'Mega Fan'

SELECT (SELECT SUM(cpm_realized) / 1000 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery) AS delivered_revenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery) AS imps, (SELECT MIN(delivery_date) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery) AS mn, (SELECT MAX(delivery_date) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.impression_delivery) AS mx, (SELECT SUM(total_contracted_value) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.ad_order) AS contracted, (SELECT SUM(net_order_value) FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_sales.ad_order) AS net_ordered LIMIT 1001

SELECT ROUND(SUM(`amount`), 2) AS `total_refunded_amount`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_billing`.`refund`
WHERE `refund_status` = 'Processed'

SELECT COUNT(`playback_session_id`) AS `sessions_with_subtitles_on`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_distribution`.`playback_session`
WHERE `subtitle_language` IS NOT NULL

WITH paying AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.subscriber_id FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription AS s JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscription_plan AS p ON p.subscription_plan_id = s.subscription_plan_id WHERE p.plan_type = 'Paid' AND s.activation_date <= CAST('2026-10-31' AS DATE) AND (s.termination_date IS NULL OR s.termination_date >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE))), w AS (SELECT subscriber_id, SUM(total_watch_duration_seconds) / 3600.0 AS hrs FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_distribution.playback_session WHERE session_start_timestamp >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND session_start_timestamp < CAST('2026-11-01' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY subscriber_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS paying_subs, COUNT(w.subscriber_id) AS with_viewing, SUM(COALESCE(w.hrs, 0)) AS total_hrs, AVG(COALESCE(w.hrs, 0)) AS avg_all, AVG(w.hrs) AS avg_viewers, PERCENTILE_APPROX(COALESCE(w.hrs, 0), 0.5) AS median_all FROM paying LEFT JOIN w USING (subscriber_id) LIMIT 1001

SELECT h.holder_id, h.rights_holder_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.license_agreement AS a JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.holder AS h ON h.holder_id = a.primary_license_holder_id WHERE a.windowing_strategy = 'Simulcast' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT h.holder_id, h.rights_holder_name, s.statement_status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(s.net_royalty_amount) AS net, s.currency_code FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.holder AS h LEFT JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.royalty_statement AS s ON s.holder_id = h.holder_id WHERE h.rights_holder_name LIKE '%Ashen%' GROUP BY ALL LIMIT 1001

WITH `studio_counts` AS (
  SELECT
    `series`.`production_company` AS `studio`,
    COUNT(*) AS `series_count`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN `series`.`finale_date` IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `still_airing_count`
  FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_content`.`series` AS `series`
  WHERE `series`.`production_company` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `series`.`production_company`
),
`ranked_studios` AS (
  SELECT
    `studio`,
    `series_count`,
    `still_airing_count`,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY `series_count` DESC) AS `studio_rank`
  FROM `studio_counts`
)
SELECT
  `studio`,
  `series_count`,
  `still_airing_count`
FROM `ranked_studios`
WHERE `studio_rank` = 1
ORDER BY `series_count` DESC, `studio` ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT `subscription`.`subscriber_id`) AS `paying_subscribers`
FROM `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription` AS `subscription`
JOIN `serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog`.`hoshi_subscriber`.`subscription_plan` AS `subscription_plan`
  ON `subscription`.`subscription_plan_id` = `subscription_plan`.`subscription_plan_id`
WHERE `subscription`.`subscription_status` = 'Active'
  AND `subscription_plan`.`plan_type` = 'Paid'
